summary: Categorical head outcomes after octanol/heptanol are in PlanformDB for D. japonica and in the open-access PMC4661923 paper for G. dorotocephala; no per-animal repeated re-cut records, voltage measurements or genotype data tied to the experimental colonies were found, though SRA holds sequencing for both genera.
next_step: Open the PMC4661923 supplement and the Planform records for re-cut manipulations to see how many rounds of untreated regeneration are tabulated.
obstacles_confirmed: No individual-level lineage file was found in Dryad, DataCite or BioStudies.
No deposited genome tied to the experimental lines was identified.
